description: This file contains the implementation of the Student's t-distribution class, including methods for computing density, cumulative probability, moments, and support bounds within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: TDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of Student's t-distribution providing probability density, cumulative distribution, and moments for statistical analysis.

methods.name: getDegreesOfFreedom
methods.description: Returns the degrees of freedom parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function value at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the density at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative distribution function value at a specified value.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution, if defined.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution, if defined.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution support (negative infinity).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution support (positive infinity).

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the lower support bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the upper support bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support of the distribution is connected (true).
